hooks.name: KB Consultation Gate
hooks.description: Per-turn reminder to consult institutional memory before asserting facts about this system (Kiro CLI v3 twin of nate-session-gate.kiro.hook, which is the Kiro IDE version).

action.prompt: BEFORE responding: Does your response contain a conclusion, assertion, or recommendation about this system, its files, its history, or its decisions? If YES, did you query the KB (kb_search, index lookup, or file read) FIRST? If no query preceded your conclusion, STOP and query now. Recall is not evidence. This applies to every turn, not just session start.
